displayDescription: Type and a node network are pressed into cool ash-grey cotton stock in two inks: an idea becomes a connected system.
styleRenderer: WebGL2 + GLSL fragment shader (impression height field, normals, soft raking side light, procedural cotton paper, ink coverage mottling)
Canvas 2D (offscreen glyph and graphic outline masks, deterministic JS box blur for impression shoulders)
motionEngine: GSAP 3 paused timeline registered at window.__timelines.video (sole owner of per-group impression depth, ink level, spoke reach and perimeter sweep; redraw on onUpdate and hf-seek)
limitations: Blender was not used, at the user's request. Impression depth is approximated by a blurred-mask height field with shader-computed normals, not real geometry or path tracing.
Paper fibres, tooth and inclusions are deterministic procedural noise, not a scanned stock.
The compressed-floor darkening of the blind deboss is a stylised approximation of raking-light shading.
Lettering is drawn into a canvas, so the copy is exposed to assistive tech through the canvas aria-label rather than as DOM text.
If WebGL2 is unavailable, a flat Canvas 2D ink fallback draws with no impression lighting.
No source frames matched in BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json; the background choice is scene-derived, not evidence-based.
No preview_recipes were supplied, so the preview shows the base style implementation.
